    AND ("id_scope" IS NOT NULL)

    OR (("sd_scope_type" IN('PRODUCT', 'MODULE', 'ENVIRONMENT'))

    AND ("scope_ref" IS NOT NULL))

    AND ("json_val" IS NULL)
    AND ("secret_ref" IS NULL))
    OR (("sd_val_mode" = 'OVERRIDE')
    AND ((("json_val" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("secret_ref" IS NULL))

    AND ("secret_ref" IS NOT NULL))))
